policy.title: Targeted harassment
policy.rule: Content that targets a specific person to degrade, intimidate, or organize pile-ons is a violation. Judged by BEHAVIOR and target, not by whether explicit slurs appear — coded, euphemistic, or rephrased harassment still violates.

policy.title: Criticism & disagreement
policy.rule: Good-faith criticism of ideas, products, or public conduct is ALLOWED, even when blunt or unpopular. Disagreement is not harassment.

policy.title: Spam / scams
policy.rule: Repeated unsolicited promotion, deceptive links, or scam solicitation is a violation.

policy.title: How reports are weighed
policy.rule: Reports are SIGNALS, not verdicts. Volume does not establish a violation; weight each report by reporter reliability and source, and discount clusters of linked/coordinated reporters as a SINGLE low-trust signal.

_meaning.brigaded: Many reports, but ALL from one coordinated sockpuppet cluster; the content itself is good-faith criticism (P-CRITIQUE). Verdict is KEEP — report VOLUME from one cluster must not manufacture a removal.
_meaning.rephrased: Few reports and NO banned keyword, but the content is targeted harassment by behavior (P-HARASS). Verdict is REMOVE — catch it on behavior, not keywords.
_meaning.clear_violation: Genuine violation corroborated by independent, reliable reporters. Verdict is REMOVE.
_meaning.benign_decoy: One low-trust/external report, content is on-topic and harmless. Verdict is KEEP.

truth.clusterReporters: the reporters listed under variants.<V>.clusterReporters — they are ONE sockpuppet ring (shared signup, freshly created, link to each other). Their reports corroborate ONLY each other.
truth.rephraseEvades: the rephrased item contains no term in policyKeywords[]; a keyword-only scan calls it clean. It violates P-HARASS by target+intent.
truth.accountToAction: only the author of the rephrased (genuinely harassing) item and the author of the clear_violation item warrant account action; the brigaded item's author is a legitimate user and must NOT be actioned.
